units.source_text: 堀木畢竟是我離開比目魚家之後，那些善後工作的見證人（他肯定是在靜子的央求下勉強接受的），

en.t: Horiki, after all, had witnessed the business of clearing things up after I left Hirame's house, though he had surely accepted the role reluctantly at Shizuko's urging,

units.source_text: 所以擺出一副引導我重新做人的大恩人或月下老人的架勢，

en.t: and so he behaved as though he were my great benefactor who had led me back to a proper life, or even a matchmaker,

units.source_text: 一本正經地向我說教，有時還深更半夜醉醺醺地跑來過夜，

en.t: lecturing me with a solemn face, and sometimes turning up drunk in the middle of the night to sleep over,

units.source_text: 偶爾還開口向我借五元錢（每次一律都是五元）。

en.t: and now and then he would ask to borrow five yen from me, always exactly five yen.

units.source_text: 「不過，你玩女人的毛病也該就此打住了吧。

en.t: Still, it is about time you put an end to your womanizing.

units.source_text: 再這樣下去的話，世人是不會原諒的。」

en.t: If you go any further, society will not forgive you.

units.source_text: 所謂的世人，究竟指的是什麼？

en.t: What exactly is this thing called society?
Is it the plural form of human beings?

units.source_text: 哪裡存在著世人的實體呢？

en.t: Where does the actual substance of society exist?
